units: Kil. VI, 1 איזהו ע׳ הנוטע וכ׳ what is an ʿaris (in a legal sense)? A row of (at least) five vines along a fence.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 6:2">Ib. 2</cite> <he>ע׳ היוצא מן המדרגה</he> an espalier that hangs over an embankment.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 6:6">Ib. 6</cite> (expl. <he>פסקי ע׳</he>) <he>ע׳ שחרב וכ׳</he> an espalier which was destroyed in the middle, while five vines remained on each side; <cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 4:8">Tosef. ib. IV, 8</cite> <he>חריס</he> ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. <cite ref="H01690"><he>חריץ</he></cite>; corr. acc.); Y. ib. VI, end, 30ᶜ (also <cite ref="P01404"><he>עֶרֶס</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 6:8">Kil. VI, 8</cite> <he>הקנים היוצאים מן הע׳</he> poles which stand out from an espalier; a. fr.—Pl. <he>עֲרִיסִין</he>.
